description: Inserts an image on a slide (batchUpdate createImage) from EITHER image_url — a public https URL Google's servers can fetch (validated: https-only, no private/local hosts, ≤2 kB; the image itself must be PNG/JPEG/GIF, ≤50 MB, ≤25 megapixels) — OR image_path, a local file that is checked by magic bytes, uploaded to Drive, shared by link for the fetch and DELETED from Drive right after (Slides stores its own copy, so the temp file is disposable; the result reports the cleanup). Omitted size keeps the image's native proportions fitted to the page; position/size are in points. Returns the image objectId in the reply.

image_path.description: Absolute local path of a PNG/JPEG/GIF file (exactly one of image_url / image_path).

image_url.description: Public https URL of a PNG/JPEG/GIF (exactly one of image_url / image_path).

object_id.description: Optional custom object id for the new image.

page_object_id.description: The slide's object id to place the image on (from list_slides).

presentation_id.description: The presentation id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/presentation/d/<presentationId>/edit) or from create_presentation output.

name: create_image
title: Insert an image
